maria: Quick heads-up 99we need a crisp MVP checklist for the Optimize pilot (AcmeHealth asks: adaptive batching hints, a safe quant fallback, eval-triggered alerts). Can we agree on a minimal scope by EOD?
chen: Yes. Propose two pilot modes: latency-mode (conservative batching + KV cache) and econ-mode (aggressive batching + optional 8-bit quant).
oliver: Quant fallback must be per-customer and signal-driven only. no surprise quality drops.
sam: Suggested eval alert: concordance drop >6% over last 10k evalled requests, with 30m debounce and manual mute.
maria: Rollout: 5% canary -> 20% -> 100% with telemetry gates and automatic rollback on regressions. ops gets prompt examples on alert.
chen: Draft acceptance items: 1) Console toggles + advanced YAML editor; 2) batching estimator (moving-avg seq length, 1k sample) + static presets fallback; 3) quant fallback path + smoke tests; 4) eval-alert pipeline to SLOs and #eng-oncall; 5) canary automation + rollback hook.
sam: I'll own the alert templates and thresholds.
maria: Action items: @chen estimator proto, @oliver quant smoke, @sam alerts spec, I'll coordinate canary with ops. 30m demo Thursday. :thumbsup:
